scripts.build:wasm: npx -y wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir packages/docx-editor/wasm --out-name docx_engine && rm -f packages/docx-editor/wasm/package.json packages/docx-editor/wasm/.gitignore packages/docx-editor/wasm/README.md packages/docx-editor/wasm/LICENSE
scripts.build:wasm:xlsx: npx -y wasm-pack build crates/xlsx-engine --target web --out-dir ../../packages/xlsx/wasm --out-name xlsx_engine && rm -f packages/xlsx/wasm/package.json packages/xlsx/wasm/.gitignore packages/xlsx/wasm/README.md packages/xlsx/wasm/LICENSE
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build -w apps/demo
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y wrangler deploy
